-- ============================================================
-- FAVOUR BOT — Complete Reproducible Schema
-- Safe to run on a fresh Postgres instance
-- Last updated: June 2026
-- ============================================================

-- Extensions
CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS vector;

-- Sequences
CREATE SEQUENCE IF NOT EXISTS favour_customer_code_seq START 1;

-- Customers
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS favour_customers (
    id                      uuid        PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    wa_id                   text        UNIQUE NOT NULL,
    customer_code           text        UNIQUE DEFAULT 'DTP-' || LPAD(nextval('favour_customer_code_seq')::text, 3, '0'),
    display_name            text,
    first_seen_at           timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    last_seen_at            timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    message_count           int         NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    positive_interactions   int         NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
);

-- Conversations
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS favour_conversations (
    id              uuid        PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    customer_id     uuid        NOT NULL REFERENCES favour_customers(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    started_at      timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    last_msg_at     timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

-- Messages
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS favour_messages (
    id                  uuid    PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    conversation_id     uuid    NOT NULL REFERENCES favour_conversations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    customer_id         uuid    NOT NULL REFERENCES favour_customers(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    role                text    NOT NULL CHECK (role IN ('user', 'assistant')),
    content             text    NOT NULL,
    created_at          timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

-- Documents
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS favour_documents (
    id              uuid        PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    file_name       text        UNIQUE NOT NULL,
    bucket          text        NOT NULL DEFAULT 'favors-rag',
    ingested_at     timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    chunk_count     int         NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
);

-- Embeddings
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS favour_embeddings (
    id              uuid        PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    document_id     uuid        NOT NULL REFERENCES favour_documents(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    file_name       text        NOT NULL,
    chunk_index     int         NOT NULL,
    content         text        NOT NULL,
    embedding       vector(3072),
    created_at      timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

-- Escalations
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS favour_escalations (
    id                  uuid        PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    customer_id         uuid        NOT NULL REFERENCES favour_customers(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    conversation_id     uuid        NOT NULL REFERENCES favour_conversations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    reason              text,
    context             text,
    resolved            boolean     NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
    admin_response      text,
    resolved_at         timestamptz,
    created_at          timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

-- Indexes
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_favour_messages_conversation    ON favour_messages(conversation_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_favour_messages_customer        ON favour_messages(customer_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_favour_embeddings_document      ON favour_embeddings(document_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_favour_embeddings_file          ON favour_embeddings(file_name);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_favour_escalations_customer     ON favour_escalations(customer_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_favour_conversations_customer   ON favour_conversations(customer_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_favour_customers_wa_id          ON favour_customers(wa_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_favour_customers_code           ON favour_customers(customer_code);

-- Weekly Summary View (live rolling 7-day window)
CREATE VIEW favour_weekly_summary AS
SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT id) 
   FROM table_1
   column_1 CURRENT_DATE)           AS total_engaged,

  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM table_1
   column_1= CURRENT_DATE - interval '7 days'
   column_1 CURRENT_DATE)             AS new_joiners,

  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM table_2
   column_2 'user'
   column_3= CURRENT_DATE - interval '7 days'
   column_3 CURRENT_DATE
   AND (
     content ILIKE '%thank%' OR content ILIKE '%thanks%' OR
     content ILIKE '%appreciate%' OR content ILIKE '%helpful%' OR
     content ILIKE '%great%' OR content ILIKE '%perfect%' OR
     content ILIKE '%excellent%' OR content ILIKE '%wonderful%' OR
     content ILIKE '%awesome%' OR content ILIKE '%noted%'
   ))                                            AS codes_redeemed,

  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM table_2
   column_2 'user'
   column_3= CURRENT_DATE - interval '7 days'
   column_3 CURRENT_DATE
   AND content NOT ILIKE '%thank%'
   AND content NOT ILIKE '%thanks%'
   AND content NOT ILIKE '%appreciate%'
   AND content NOT ILIKE '%helpful%'
   AND content NOT ILIKE '%great%'
   AND content NOT ILIKE '%perfect%'
   AND content NOT ILIKE '%excellent%'
   AND content NOT ILIKE '%wonderful%'
   AND content NOT ILIKE '%awesome%'
   AND content NOT ILIKE '%noted%'
   AND content NOT ILIKE '%hi%'
   AND content NOT ILIKE '%hello%'
   AND content NOT ILIKE '%hey%'
   AND content NOT ILIKE '%good morning%'
   AND content NOT ILIKE '%good afternoon%'
   AND content NOT ILIKE '%good evening%')       AS complaints_queries;

INSERT INTO table_6 (file_name, bucket, ingested_at, chunk_count)
VALUES ($1, 'favors-rag', now(), $2)
ON CONFLICT (file_name)
DO UPDATE column_4 now(),
  chunk_count = EXCLUDED.chunk_count
RETURNING id
DELETE FROM table_7 column_5 $1

INSERT INTO table_7 (document_id, file_name, chunk_index, content, embedding)
VALUES ($1::uuid, $2, $3, $4, $5::vector)
SELECT * FROM table_1

SELECT
  id,
  customer_code,
  display_name,
  message_count,
  first_seen_at
FROM table_1
column_6 $1
LIMIT 1

INSERT INTO table_1 (wa_id, display_name, message_count, first_seen_at, last_seen_at)
VALUES ($1, $2, 1, now(), now())
RETURNING id, customer_code, display_name, message_count, first_seen_at

UPDATE table_1
column_7 now(), message_count = message_count + 1
column_6 $1
RETURNING id, customer_code, display_name, message_count, first_seen_at

INSERT INTO table_12 (customer_id, started_at, last_msg_at)
VALUES ($1::uuid, now(), now())
ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
RETURNING id AS conversation_id;

-- Upsert: get existing open conversation or create new
WITH upsert AS (
  INSERT INTO table_12 (customer_id, started_at, last_msg_at)
  SELECT $1::uuid, now(), now()
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM table_12
    column_8 $1::uuid
    column_9 now() - interval '2 hours'
  )
  RETURNING id
)
SELECT id AS conversation_id FROM table_13
UNION ALL
SELECT id AS conversation_id FROM table_12
column_8 $1::uuid
  column_9 now() - interval '2 hours'
ORDER BY conversation_id DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT role, content FROM table_2
column_10 $1::uuid
ORDER BY created_at DESC
LIMIT 8

SELECT content, chunk_index, file_name,
  1 - (embedding <=> $1::vector) AS similarity
FROM table_7
ORDER BY embedding <=> $1::vector
LIMIT 5

INSERT INTO table_2 (conversation_id, customer_id, role, content, created_at)
VALUES
  ($1::uuid, $2::uuid, 'user',      $3, now()),
  ($1::uuid, $2::uuid, 'assistant', $4, now());
 
UPDATE table_1
column_11 positive_interactions + 1
column_12 $2::uuid
  AND $5 = true;

INSERT INTO table_14 (customer_id, conversation_id, reason, context, resolved, created_at)
VALUES ($1::uuid, $2::uuid, $3, $4, false, now())
RETURNING id

SELECT
  e.id,
  e.customer_id,
  e.conversation_id,
  e.context AS original_message,
  c.wa_id,
  c.customer_code
FROM table_14 e
JOIN table_1 c ON c.id = e.customer_id
WHERE e.id = $1::uuid
LIMIT 1

UPDATE table_14
column_13 true,
  admin_response = $2,
  resolved_at = now()
column_12 $1::uuid

INSERT INTO table_2 (conversation_id, customer_id, role, content, created_at)
VALUES ($1::uuid, $2::uuid, 'assistant', $3, now())

SELECT
  -- Total unique customers who messaged today
  COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) FILTER (
    WHERE DATE(created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Africa/Lagos') = CURRENT_DATE
    column_2 'user'
  ) AS active_customers,

  -- Positive sentiments today (user messages containing thank/thanks etc)
  COUNT(*) FILTER (
    WHERE DATE(created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Africa/Lagos') = CURRENT_DATE
    column_2 'user'
    AND (
      content ILIKE '%thank%' OR content ILIKE '%thanks%' OR
      content ILIKE '%appreciate%' OR content ILIKE '%helpful%' OR
      content ILIKE '%great%' OR content ILIKE '%perfect%' OR
      content ILIKE '%excellent%' OR content ILIKE '%wonderful%' OR
      content ILIKE '%awesome%' OR content ILIKE '%noted%'
    )
  ) AS positive_sentiments,

  -- Other messages (user messages that are NOT positive sentiment AND not a first greeting)
  COUNT(*) FILTER (
    WHERE DATE(created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Africa/Lagos') = CURRENT_DATE
    column_2 'user'
    AND content NOT ILIKE '%thank%'
    AND content NOT ILIKE '%thanks%'
    AND content NOT ILIKE '%appreciate%'
    AND content NOT ILIKE '%helpful%'
    AND content NOT ILIKE '%great%'
    AND content NOT ILIKE '%perfect%'
    AND content NOT ILIKE '%excellent%'
    AND content NOT ILIKE '%wonderful%'
    AND content NOT ILIKE '%awesome%'
    AND content NOT ILIKE '%noted%'
    AND content NOT ILIKE '%hi%'
    AND content NOT ILIKE '%hello%'
    AND content NOT ILIKE '%hey%'
    AND content NOT ILIKE '%good morning%'
    AND content NOT ILIKE '%good afternoon%'
    AND content NOT ILIKE '%good evening%'
  ) AS other_messages

FROM table_2

SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS new_customers_today,
  COALESCE(
    string_agg(customer_code || ' (' || COALESCE(display_name, 'Unknown') || ')', ', ' ORDER BY first_seen_at),
    'None'
  ) AS new_customer_list
FROM table_1
WHERE DATE(first_seen_at AT TIME ZONE 'Africa/Lagos') = CURRENT_DATE

SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS total_customers_alltime
FROM table_1
